versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד זֶ֣ה ה֔וּא בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְזֶה־מִּזְבֵּ֥חַ לְעֹלָ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: Then David said, “This is the house of Yahweh God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”
controles.kjv: Then David said, This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.
controles.livre: E disse Davi: Esta é a casa do SENHOR Deus, e este é o altar do holocausto para Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד לִכְנוֹס֙ אֶת־הַגֵּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּעֲמֵ֣ד חֹֽצְבִ֗ים לַחְצוֹב֙ אַבְנֵ֣י גָזִ֔ית לִבְנ֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut worked stones to build God’s house.
controles.kjv: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
controles.livre: Depois mandou Davi que se juntassem os estrangeiros que estavam na terra de Israel, e assinalou deles pedreiros que lavrassem pedras para edificar a casa de Deus.

versos.hebraico: וּבַרְזֶ֣ל׀ לָ֠רֹב לַֽמִּסְמְרִ֞ים לְדַלְת֧וֹת הַשְּׁעָרִ֛ים וְלַֽמְחַבְּר֖וֹת הֵכִ֣ין דָּוִ֑יד וּנְחֹ֥שֶׁת לָרֹ֖ב אֵ֥ין מִשְׁקָֽל׃

controles.web: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the couplings; and brass in abundance without weight;
controles.kjv: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
controles.livre: Assim preparou Davi muito ferro para os pregos das portas, e para as junturas; e muito metal sem peso, e madeira de cedro sem conta.

versos.hebraico: וַעֲצֵ֥י אֲרָזִ֖ים לְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּֽי הֵ֠בִיאוּ הַצִּֽידֹנִ֨ים וְהַצֹּרִ֜ים עֲצֵ֧י אֲרָזִ֛ים לָרֹ֖ב לְדָוִֽיד׃פ

controles.web: and cedar trees without number: for the Sidonians and they of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.
controles.kjv: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.
controles.livre: Porque os sidônios e tírios haviam trazido a Davi madeira de cedro inumerável.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗יד שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִי֮ נַ֣עַר וָרָךְ֒ וְהַבַּ֜יִת לִבְנ֣וֹת לַיהוָ֗ה לְהַגְדִּ֨יל׀ לְמַ֜עְלָה לְשֵׁ֤ם וּלְתִפְאֶ֨רֶת֙ לְכָל־הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אָכִ֥ינָה נָּ֖א ל֑וֹ וַיָּ֧כֶן דָּוִ֛יד לָרֹ֖ב לִפְנֵ֥י מוֹתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for Yahweh must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.
controles.kjv: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the Lord must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.
controles.livre: E disse Davi: Salomão meu filho é jovem e tenro, e a casa que se há de edificar a o SENHOR há de ser magnífica por excelência, para nome e honra em todas as terras; agora pois eu lhe prepararei o necessário. E preparou Davi antes de sua morte em grande abundância.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֖א לִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֑וֹ וַיְצַוֵּ֨הוּ֙ לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for Yahweh, the God of Israel.
controles.kjv: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the Lord God of Israel.
controles.livre: Chamou então Davi a Salomão seu filho, e mandou-lhe que edificasse casa a o SENHOR Deus de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר דָּוִ֖יד לִשְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בנו אֲנִי֙ הָיָ֣ה עִם־לְבָבִ֔י לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃

controles.web: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of Yahweh my God.
controles.kjv: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the Lord my God:
controles.livre: E disse Davi a Salomão: Filho meu, em meu coração tive o edificar templo ao nome do SENHOR meu Deus.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֨י עָלַ֤י דְּבַר־יְהוָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר דָּ֤ם לָרֹב֙ שָׁפַ֔כְתָּ וּמִלְחָמ֥וֹת גְּדֹל֖וֹת עָשִׂ֑יתָ לֹֽא־תִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֨יִת֙ לִשְׁמִ֔י כִּ֚י דָּמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים שָׁפַ֥כְתָּ אַ֖רְצָה לְפָנָֽי׃

controles.web: But Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly, and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.
controles.kjv: But the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
controles.livre: Mas veio a mim palavra do SENHOR, dizendo: Tu derramaste muito sangue, e trouxeste grandes guerras: não edificarás casa a meu nome, porque derramaste muito sangue na terra diante de mim:

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּה־בֵ֞ן נוֹלָ֣ד לָ֗ךְ ה֤וּא יִהְיֶה֙ אִ֣ישׁ מְנוּחָ֔ה וַהֲנִח֥וֹתִי ל֛וֹ מִכָּל־אוֹיְבָ֖יו מִסָּבִ֑יב כִּ֤י שְׁלֹמֹה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שְׁמ֔וֹ וְשָׁל֥וֹם וָשֶׁ֛קֶט אֶתֵּ֥ן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּיָמָֽיו׃

controles.web: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of rest. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.
controles.kjv: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
controles.livre: Eis aqui, um filho te nascerá, o qual será homem de repouso, porque eu lhe darei quietude de todos seus inimigos em derredor; por tanto seu nome será Salomão; e eu darei paz e repouso sobre Israel em seus dias:

versos.hebraico: הֽוּא־יִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֨יִת֙ לִשְׁמִ֔י וְהוּא֙ יִהְיֶה־לִּ֣י לְבֵ֔ן וַאֲנִי־ל֖וֹ לְאָ֑ב וַהֲכִ֨ינוֹתִ֜י כִּסֵּ֧א מַלְכוּת֛וֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: He shall build a house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.’
controles.kjv: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
controles.livre: Ele edificará casa a meu nome, e ele me será a mim por filho, e eu lhe serei por pai; e afirmarei o trono de seu reino sobre Israel para sempre.

versos.hebraico: עַתָּ֣ה בְנִ֔י יְהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּ֑ךְ וְהִצְלַחְתָּ֗ וּבָנִ֨יתָ֙ בֵּ֚ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר עָלֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Now, my son, may Yahweh be with you and prosper you, and build the house of Yahweh your God, as he has spoken concerning you.
controles.kjv: Now, my son, the Lord be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the Lord thy God, as he hath said of thee.
controles.livre: Agora, pois, filho meu, seja contigo o SENHOR, e sejas próspero, e edifiques casa a o SENHOR teu Deus, como ele disse de ti.

versos.hebraico: אַ֣ךְ יִֽתֶּן־לְּךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ שֵׂ֣כֶל וּבִינָ֔ה וִֽיצַוְּךָ֖ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלִשְׁמ֕וֹר אֶת־תּוֹרַ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: May Yahweh give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel; that so you may keep the law of Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: Only the Lord give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the Lord thy God.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR te dê entendimento e prudência, e ele te dê mandamentos para Israel; e que tu guardes a lei do SENHOR teu Deus.

versos.hebraico: אָ֣ז תַּצְלִ֔יחַ אִם־תִּשְׁמ֗וֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲזַ֣ק וֶאֱמָ֔ץ אַל־תִּירָ֖א וְאַל־תֵּחָֽת׃

controles.web: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which Yahweh gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong, and courageous. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.
controles.kjv: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the Lord charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.
controles.livre: Então serás próspero, se cuidares de pôr por obra os estatutos e direitos que o SENHOR mandou a Moisés para Israel. Esforça-te pois, e recobra ânimo; não temas, nem desmaies.

versos.hebraico: וְהִנֵּ֨ה בְעָנְיִ֜י הֲכִינ֣וֹתִי לְבֵית־יְהוָ֗ה זָהָ֞ב כִּכָּרִ֤ים מֵֽאָה־אֶ֨לֶף֙ וְכֶ֗סֶף אֶ֤לֶף אֲלָפִים֙ כִּכָּרִ֔ים וְלַנְּחֹ֤שֶׁת וְלַבַּרְזֶל֙ אֵ֣ין מִשְׁקָ֔ל כִּ֥י לָרֹ֖ב הָיָ֑ה וְעֵצִ֤ים וַאֲבָנִים֙ הֲכִינ֔וֹתִי וַעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם תּוֹסִֽיף׃

controles.web: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for Yahweh’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.
controles.kjv: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the Lord an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.
controles.livre: Eis aqui, eu em minha estreiteza preveni para a casa do SENHOR cem mil talentos de ouro, e um milhar de milhares de talentos de prata: não tem peso o metal nem o ferro, porque é muito. Assim aprontei madeira e pedra, a o qual tu acrescentarás.

versos.hebraico: וְעִמְּךָ֤ לָרֹב֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י מְלָאכָ֔ה חֹצְבִ֕ים וְחָרָשֵׁ֥י אֶ֖בֶן וָעֵ֑ץ וְכָל־חָכָ֖ם בְּכָל־מְלָאכָֽה׃

controles.web: There are also workmen with you in abundance, cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work:
controles.kjv: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.
controles.livre: Tu tens contigo muitos oficiais, pedreiros, pedreiros, e carpinteiros, e todo homem especialista em toda obra.

versos.hebraico: לַזָּהָ֥ב לַכֶּ֛סֶף וְלַנְּחֹ֥שֶׁת וְלַבַּרְזֶ֖ל אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר ק֣וּם וַעֲשֵׂ֔ה וִיהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may Yahweh be with you.”
controles.kjv: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the Lord be with thee.
controles.livre: Do ouro, da prata, do metal, e do ferro, não há número. Levanta-te, pois, e à obra; que o SENHOR será contigo.

versos.hebraico: וַיְצַ֤ו דָּוִיד֙ לְכָל־שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעְזֹ֖ר לִשְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
controles.kjv: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
controles.livre: Assim mandou Davi a todos os principais de Israel que dessem ajuda a Salomão seu filho, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: הֲלֹ֨א יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְהֵנִ֥יחַ לָכֶ֖ם מִסָּבִ֑יב כִּ֣י׀ נָתַ֣ן בְּיָדִ֗י אֵ֚ת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֥ה הָאָ֛רֶץ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְלִפְנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “Isn’t Yahweh your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before Yahweh, and before his people.
controles.kjv: Is not the Lord your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the Lord, and before his people.
controles.livre: Não é convosco o SENHOR vosso Deus, o qual vos há dado quietude de todas as partes? Porque ele entregou em minha mão os moradores da terra, e a terra há sido sujeitada diante do SENHOR, e diante de seu povo.

versos.hebraico: עַתָּ֗ה תְּנ֤וּ לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְנַפְשְׁכֶ֔ם לִדְר֖וֹשׁ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְק֗וּמוּ וּבְנוּ֙ אֶת־מִקְדַּשׁ֙ יְהוָ֣ה הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהָבִ֞יא אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֗ה וּכְלֵי֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לַבַּ֖יִת הַנִּבְנֶ֥ה לְשֵׁם־יְהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: Now set your heart and your soul to seek after Yahweh your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of Yahweh God, to bring the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built for Yahweh’s name.”
controles.kjv: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the Lord your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the Lord God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the Lord.
controles.livre: Ponde, pois, agora vossos corações e vossos ânimos em buscar a o SENHOR vosso Deus; e levantai-vos, e edificai o santuário do Deus o SENHOR, para trazer a arca do pacto do SENHOR, e o santos vasos de Deus, à casa edificada ao nome do SENHOR.
